title: secure-cicd-kit repository profile
description: Declares what a class of repository gets from the kit: which scans run, which gates block, and how it deploys. A profile is the intent; the reusable workflows are the implementation. Employer-neutral — no org, registry, tenant, or resource identifiers belong here.

description.description: What kind of repository this profile is for.

language.description: Primary language, passed to the security suite.

security.description: Which scans run and which of them block a merge.

enable_iac.description: Run Checkov + Trivy config over Terraform/IaC.

soft_fail_sast.description: SAST reports SARIF without blocking. Intended for adoption only.

fail_on_severity.description: Comma-separated severities that fail dependency/container scans.

required_gates.description: Scans that must pass before merge. These become the repo's required checks.

sbom.description: Generate and retain an SPDX SBOM for every image.

image_scan_gate.description: Trivy must pass BEFORE the image is pushed, not after.

require_sha_pinned_actions.description: Third-party actions must be pinned to a full commit SHA.

trivy_severity.description: Container severities that block the push.

deploy.description: Deployment shape. Omit entirely for library repositories that never deploy.

target.description: Which deploy reusable this profile calls.

partitions.description: Cloud partitions this profile deploys to. Dual-partition parity is achieved by inputs, never by forked pipelines.

by_digest.description: Deploy by immutable image digest. Tag-based deploys are policy violations.

gated.description: Deploys require a GitHub Environment approval; never automatic on push.

health_path.description: Health probe path used to prove the deploy before traffic moves.

rollback.description: What happens when the health probe fails.
